notes: Icon is the raw Apple grapes emoji, NOT a designed macOS app icon. Source only 100x100px transparent web render -> all hex (estimated), fine detail anti-aliased away. Strongest asset: instantly-nameable silhouette + coherent single light model (both Apple's, not the dev's). Fatal issues: no squircle/background (mask fail) and no layer separation for Liquid Glass variants. Brand incoherence: cover UI is dark-charcoal monochrome bold-sans with zero purple — icon shares no palette or mood with the product. For synthesis: this is the canonical 'shipped the OS emoji as the icon' anti-pattern; keep out of any icon canon promotion. Do NOT treat its palette/economy passes as authored craft.
